name: PathBuilder
src_typeComment: The generation half of the Unified Path Builder: takes the SplinePath on the same object and either (a) spawns a prefab repeatedly along it, or (b) extrudes a road-style mesh along it. Click "Generate" in the Inspector (or call Generate() from code) any time the path changes — nothing regenerates automatically, so editing points stays cheap even on a large path (same rule the LevelTransformGuidance hub follows: no per-frame whole-scene work, recompute on demand).

src_serialized.name: fixedDistance
src_serialized.tooltip: Used when Spacing Mode is Fixed Distance: world units between each instance's centre.

src_serialized.name: boundsAxis
src_serialized.tooltip: Used when Spacing Mode is Prefab Bounds: which local axis of the PREFAB itself is its \"length\" — the direction consecutive instances should butt against each other along.

src_serialized.name: boundsPadding
src_serialized.tooltip: Extra gap added between instances on top of their measured bounds size. Negative values overlap them slightly.

src_serialized.name: alignToTangent
src_serialized.tooltip: Rotates each instance so its local +Z faces the path's direction of travel at that point. Turn off to keep every instance at this object's own rotation instead.

src_serialized.name: rotationOverrides
src_serialized.tooltip: Extra yaw in degrees, one entry per spawned instance in spawn order, applied ON TOP of the tangent-facing base rotation. Resize freely — fewer entries than instances pads with 0, more are ignored. This is the per-instance rotation override: dial one in, click Generate again. A manual rotation made by dragging a spawned instance directly in the Scene view will NOT survive the next Generate() unless it is also entered here — Generate always rebuilds from this list.

src_serialized.name: roadWidth
src_serialized.tooltip: Width of the road ribbon, across the path.

src_serialized.name: roadCrossSectionHeight
src_serialized.tooltip: Thickness of the road slab. The cross-section extruded along the path is a roadWidth x roadCrossSectionHeight rectangle, not a paper-thin plane, so the result reads as a real object and will not z-fight with terrain sitting flush underneath it.

src_serialized.name: roadSmoothness
src_serialized.tooltip: Cross-sections generated per path segment. Higher gives a smoother curve and smoother elevation transitions where path points differ in height (\"smoothness\"); lower is cheaper and more faceted.

src_serialized.name: roadUvTileLength
src_serialized.tooltip: World units of road length per full UV tile, so a tiling road texture repeats at a consistent scale regardless of the path's total length.
